Name: fd-01
Title: Awakening
Line: You wake in a fractured forest with no memory of arriving — only a signal, pulling.

Name: fd-02
Title: First Resonance
Line: The forest's wildlife is fractured too — corrupted, aggressive, and drawn to you specifically.

Name: fd-03
Title: Broken Signal
Line: The signal isn't natural. Something built it, and it wants you to find the source.

Name: fd-04
Title: Into the Shrouded Swamps
Line: The treeline ends where the fog begins — the Shrouded Swamps, the forest's corrupted twin.

Name: fd-05
Title: Crossing the Shrouded Swamps
Line: Bio-tech mutation thick enough to breathe. Something in the reeds is watching you cross.
ObjectivesJson: [{"type":"SURVIVE","label":"Hold out in the fog (s)","key":"swamps","amount":90},{"type":"MISSION_COMPLETE","label":"Purge the Drowned Relay","key":"drowned-relay","amount":1}]

Name: fd-06
Title: Signals in the Static
Line: Neon City: the Syndicate's corporate war-machine, sold as civilization. You just tripped a wire.
ObjectivesJson: [{"type":"MISSION_COMPLETE","label":"Pull off the Blackout Protocol","key":"blackout-protocol","amount":1},{"type":"HEAT_LEVEL","label":"Draw real heat for the first time","key":"3","amount":1}]

Name: fd-07
Title: Full Lockdown
Line: Full lockdown. Every drone in the district is hunting one signature — a Resonant Carrier. You.
ObjectivesJson: [{"type":"MISSION_COMPLETE","label":"Breach the Stitched Neon Core","key":"stitched-neon-core","amount":1},{"type":"HEAT_LEVEL","label":"Force the city into full lockdown","key":"5","amount":1}]

Name: fd-08
Title: The Desert Approach
Line: Solara's Glass Flats — old energy-harvesting ruins baking under a sky that never cools.
ObjectivesJson: [{"type":"SURVIVE","label":"Cross the Glass Flats (s)","key":"solara","amount":90},{"type":"MISSION_COMPLETE","label":"Realign Solar Array Alpha","key":"solar-array","amount":1}]

Name: fd-09
Title: Protocol Breach
Line: Nexus City — the Authority's control layer. They don't police chaos here. They erase it.
ObjectivesJson: [{"type":"HACK_COMPLETE","label":"Breach the Core Node terminal","amount":1},{"type":"MISSION_COMPLETE","label":"Open the Core Node's archive","key":"core-node","amount":1}]

Name: fd-10
Title: Sector Lockdown
Line: The Authority doesn't believe in coincidence. A full sector purge, just for you.

Name: fd-11
Title: Ember's Warning
Line: Frostspire — the isolation zone. The cold here doesn't just kill you, it makes you forget why you came.

Name: fd-12
Title: Core Fragment Recovery
Line: Ember Peaks: a reactor zone forged by war, still burning long after whatever it was built to stop.

Name: fd-13
Title: The Failure Core
Line: This is where containment failed the first time. It's about to fail again, with you inside it.
ObjectivesJson: [{"type":"SURVIVE","label":"Hold through a reality-breakdown spike (s)","key":"ember","amount":60},{"type":"MISSION_COMPLETE","label":"Vent the Failure Core","key":"failure-core","amount":1}]

Name: fd-14
Title: Grid-Iron Highway
Line: The Wasteland Rebellion holds the highway — scavengers running stolen Fracture tech against everyone.

Name: fd-15
Title: The Fuel King
Line: The Fuel King doesn't answer to the Rebellion or the Authority. He answers to whoever's still standing.

Name: fd-16
Title: Descent Protocol
Line: Beneath the waves: Thalassia, the Deepmind's ark-city, sealed since before the Fracture had a name.
ObjectivesJson: [{"type":"MISSION_COMPLETE","label":"Trace the signal to the control core","key":"descent-protocol","amount":1},{"type":"SURVIVE","label":"Time spent diving (s)","key":"thalassia-dive","amount":60}]

Name: fd-17
Title: Thalassia
Line: The Deepmind built the original Fracture tech. It wants to finish what it started — with or without you.

Name: fd-18
Title: The System Core
Line: Every layer of this broken reality answers to one system. You've finally reached it.
